source.source_locator: 教則 第3章 3.1.2(5)1)「制度概要」（教則表示ページ28 / PDF viewer 33）

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: Powered-lift機にはマルチローターと飛行機の両方の種類の限定に係る資格が必要である。
evidence.tested_misconception: Powered-lift機は独立した1種類の限定だけ取得すれば飛行できる。
evidence.reasoning_path: aircraft type = Powered-lift -> map hybrid type to certificate limitations -> require both multirotor and airplane qualifications

collision.note: Tier A。Q142はPowered-liftの飛行特性を問う。本問は同じ機体類型に対する法的な技能証明限定要件を問うため、答えを定める命題が異なる。

independent_review.rationale: 3.1.2(5)1) explicitly requires both multirotor and airplane type limitations for Powered-lift operation. Q142 tests Powered-lift flight characteristics, not the legal skill-certificate limitation requirement.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the quality-preserving 400-question contract to the B7 Chapter 3 Rules set. All 15 Tier A candidates test explicit source propositions not represented by the current 215-question accepted/source-verified canonical bank. The five Tier B candidates C001, C003, C008, C013 and C015 remain materially distinct through source-defined flight-phase, authority/exception, operation-subtype, response-sequence or moving-vehicle boundaries. None is retained as wording-only variation, none relies on a subsection marked 〔一等〕, and none is accepted merely to fill a numeric quota.
